title: The Red Shift in Estrogen Research: An Estrogen-Receptor Targeted aza-BODIPY-Estradiol Fluorescent Conjugate.
authors: Hlogyik, Tamas; Bozsity, Noemi; Borzsei, Rita; Kovacs, Benjamin; Labos, Peter; Hetenyi, Csaba; Kiricsi, Monika; Huliak, Ildiko; Kele, Zoltan; Poor, Miklos; Erostyak, Janos; Hunyadi, Attila; Zupko, Istvan; Mernyak, Erzsebet
one_liner_zh: 该文研究雌激素受体配体荧光标记物的合成与活性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Estradiol (E2) plays an important role in cell proliferation and certain brain functions. To reveal its mechanism of action, its detectability is essential. Only a few fluorescent-labeled hormonally active E2s exist in the literature, and their mechanism of action usually remains unclear. It would be of particular interest to develop novel labeled estradiol derivatives with retained biological activity and improved optical properties. Due to their superior optical characteristics, aza-BODIPY dyes are frequently used labeling agents in biomedical applications. E2 was labeled with the aza-BODIPY dye at its phenolic hydroxy function via an alkyl linker and a triazole coupling moiety. The estrogenic activity of the newly synthesized fluorescent conjugate was evaluated via transcriptional luciferase assay. Docking calculations were performed for the classical and alternative binding sites (CBS and ABS) of human estrogen receptor alpha. The terminal alkyne function was introduced into the tetraphenyl aza-BODIPY core via selective formylation, oxidation, and subsequent amidation with propargyl amine. The conjugation was achieved via Cu(I)-catalyzed azide-alkyne click reaction of the aza-BODIPY-alkyne with the 3-O-(4-azidobut-1-yl) derivative of E2. The labeled estrogen induced a dose-dependent transcriptional activity of human estrogen receptor alpha with a submicromolar EC(50) value. Docking calculations revealed that the steroid part has a perfect overlap with E2 in ABS. In CBS, however, a head-tail binding deviation was observed. A facile, fluorescent labeling methodology has been elaborated for the development of a novel red-emitting E2 conjugate with substantial estrogenic activity. Docking experiments uncovered the binding mode of the conjugate in both ABS and CBS.
abstract_zh: 雌二醇（E2）在细胞增殖及某些脑功能中发挥重要作用。为揭示其作用机制，其可检测性至关重要。文献中仅存在少数荧光标记且具有激素活性的E2，其作用机制通常仍不明确。开发具有保留生物活性及改善光学性质的新型标记雌二醇衍生物将尤为有意义。鉴于其优异的光学特性，氮杂-BODIPY染料常被用作生物医学应用中的标记剂。E2通过烷基连接臂和三唑偶联部分在其酚羟基位点被氮杂-BODIPY染料标记。新合成的荧光偶联物的雌激素活性通过转录荧光素酶实验进行评估。针对人雌激素受体α的经典及替代结合位点（CBS和ABS）进行了对接计算。末端炔基功能通过选择性甲酰化、氧化及随后与炔丙胺的酰胺化引入四苯基氮杂-BODIPY核心。偶联通过Cu(I)催化的叠氮-炔点击反应实现，涉及氮杂-BODIPY-炔与E2的3-O-(4-叠氮丁-1-基)衍生物。标记的雌激素诱导人雌激素受体α的剂量依赖性转录活性，其EC(50)值为亚微摩尔级别。对接计算揭示，甾体部分在ABS中与E2完美重叠；然而，在CBS中观察到头尾结合偏差。已开发出一种简便的荧光标记方法，用于制备具有显著雌激素活性的新型红色发射E2偶联物。对接实验揭示了该偶联物在ABS和CBS中的结合模式。
